name: skill-practice-max-unbroken
description: Skill practice whose board asks for a max-effort test ('Toes to Bar — 8 min practice. Start with a test: max unbroken reps, then 4 more sets at 40-60%'). The AI stamps isMaxReps with NO prescribed rep count, and logging now writes the athlete's max into the first set (isMax). The row must read 'Max Toes to Bar — 18', never '18 Toes to Bars' — the coach prescribed no count, so printing the athlete's own number as a prescription is a lie about the board. Secondary by classification (as the AI marks every practice) — the max must still reach the poster.
